name: Horizontally aligned comments
description: While moving a comment attached to a block, hold the Shift key to keep its connection line perfectly horizontal.

settings.name: Flip controls
settings.description: Make comments horizontally align by default. Hold Shift to drag freely.

latestUpdate.temporaryNotice: This feature was separated from the removed "Better editor comments" addon and updated so you can use the Shift key to control comment alignment.
